Message:
[SCSI] bfa: Enable IOC auto-recovery and IOC type fix.

bfa_ioc.c:
  - Enable IOC auto-recovery by default.
  - When CNA is in FC mode, return IOC type as FC (not FCoE)

bfa_iocfc.c:
  - Set fcmode before pci initialization/setup.
